# Grass

`material`

Living turf that covers temperate ground (forest and grassland). It is the top face of natural land, tinted per biome; what digging it yields is the biome's own `soilMaterial`, so a verbatim `Grass` cover is not what decides Soil.

> Make natural ground read as ground, and give the surface layer a name the biomes can point at

## Attributes

| Field | Type | Description |
| ----- | ---- | ----------- |
| density | decimal | g/cm³; loose, root-bound |
| hardness | decimal | Mohs equivalent 1–10 |
| depthBand | json | Depth band [min, max) in world units below the natural surface where a vein may form; empty when max <= min. A surface cover, never a buried vein. |
| leyGated | boolean | True when a vein of this material forms only near a ley line |
